column1: # MARATHI PENDING (port 63, DESIGN-port63 §3). Amit, 16 Nov 2026: "Survey to Quote journey is priority. Let amit
# verify it end to end in English then only start Marathi transformation." So a key added for the journey is built
# and verified in English first: its value in strings-mr.json is its ENGLISH for now, and the key is listed here.
# THESE KEYS WAIT FOR AMIT'S END-TO-END VERIFICATION OF THE SURVEY TO QUOTE JOURNEY IN ENGLISH. Nobody writes their
# Marathi before that. A key leaves this list in the commit that writes its Marathi, and from then on TxRenderTest's
# Latin scans read it like every other key.
#   key<TAB>English   the English exactly as strings-en.json has it (MrPendingTest holds the three equal, byte for byte)
# TxRenderTest's two Latin scans skip the keys listed here, and only those. No existing Marathi value is ever listed.
# Port 63 slice Q1 (16 Nov 2026) added fourteen: a four-corner mark's texts (the nine measure.* words of its sides, its
# diagonal and "to its nearest corner"; sp.shape.*; sp.measure.sides_say_x; sp.file.x_mark_x_shape_unreadable). 27 in all.
# Port 63 slice I1a (16 Nov 2026) added seven: the one step that marks and measures (DESIGN-imagemeter §12, §18) -- the laser
# chip's two lines and the 360's refusal (sp.laser.off / ready / on_360_x), the ▸ slot's two labels (sp.measure.aria.next_x /
# keep), the check's sentence with no figure (sp.measure.check_reading) and sp.reference_shown_mark. 34 in all.
# Port 63 slice I1b (23 Nov 2026) deleted ten whose last reader went (DESIGN-imagemeter §20.2): 24. The review of I1 added one,
# the bar's line after ✓ Save on a NEW capture (sp.msg.saved_filed_on_back, §22): 25 in all.
